verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's HTML API documents a first-party `return_page_markdown` boolean parameter that returns page content in markdown format instead of HTML, which directly delivers the story. The only evidence is a one-line parameter reference, so how clean the conversion is remains unshown. Missing for 10: detailed docs on markdown conversion behavior (boilerplate removal, handling of tables, links and images, interaction with JS rendering or extraction), independent or hands-on corroboration of output cleanliness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as clean markdown instead of raw HTML

citations.quote: return_page_markdown [boolean] (false) Return the page content in markdown format
